verdict.rationale: Reader is largely a stateless conversion API. Its outputs are open formats: Markdown with YAML frontmatter and JSON chunk arrays. A prebuilt open-source container image lets users self-host and leave the SaaS. Caching can also point at the user's own S3-compatible bucket, so fetched data stays portable. Missing for 10: any documented account/data export (API keys, usage history, cached content held by the hosted service), an explicit data-portability or deletion policy, and independent confirmation that the open-source branch matches the hosted features.
